issues.body: The live step invokes `scripts/ledger-identity-watch.py`, whose preflight requires the sibling `scripts/ledger-history-purge.py`, but that scanner does not exist anywhere in this PR-head checkout and is not added by this diff. Consequently every scheduled run at this head deterministically classifies the ledger as `unverified`; it can never inspect history or produce `clean`/`exposed`. The comment that the scanner lands in another PR does not make this change operationally complete, and merging in this order creates a permanently alarming detector rather than the standing measurement claimed by the PR.
issues.fix_hint: Do not enable the scheduled workflow until the scanner is present on the same default-branch revision. Include the scanner in this change, establish the dependency first, or otherwise gate deployment so the first enabled run can execute the real scan; add an integration assertion against the actual scanner CLI rather than only a stand-in path.
issues.title: The scheduled workflow ships without the scanner it requires

issues.body: If `gh issue list` exits zero but yields malformed JSON or a non-array JSON value, `main()` prints a warning and returns 0 without creating or updating an alert. This is a loss of the alert transport/dedupe evidence, yet Actions records the detector as healthy. On a first exposed or unverified tick there may be no pre-existing issue to remain visible, so the failure produces neither an ops alert nor a failed workflow. The self-test explicitly cements this behavior with the `soft skip` expectations, making the gap intentional rather than incidental.
issues.fix_hint: Treat unparseable or schema-invalid issue-list output as a failed tick (nonzero) so the workflow visibly fails and can be retried; do not report success when dedupe/recovery state is unavailable. Update both malformed-list self-test rows to require the fail-closed result while still asserting no mutation and no payload echo.
issues.title: Malformed issue-list data fails open as a successful, alertless tick

verdict.summary: The watcher has a sound clean/exposed/unverified polarity in its core decision logic, but the shipped workflow cannot perform its advertised measurement from this checkout because its required scanner is absent. In addition, one transport-integrity failure is deliberately converted into a successful workflow run with no alert delivery. Both defects leave the standing detector unable to establish or communicate ledger health, so this is not complete or fail-closed enough to approve.
